summary: A compact, playable launch beat with a clear progression: meager iftar, admitted fear, mutual protection, then the boarding order. The rotor-volume choices are credible, Sayed carries the emotional turn, and the single factual VO remains restrained. Mahmoud and Adel are slightly less individualized, but every line is broadcast-ready.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Pass the dates briskly without turning the line into a speech. Throw the Sinai joke down the line to keep the young men moving and eating.

lines.text: بَلَحَةْ وِبُقّْ مَيَّةْ! الْعَشَا بُكْرَةْ فِي سِينَا!

lines.speaker: ADEL
issues: «يِكُونْ فِيهْ عِيشْ» is natural and playable, but it identifies Adel only broadly as a young joker.

performance.delivery: Take the date and answer Sayed at once, grinning because joking is easier than looking at the aircraft. Do not wait for a laugh.

lines.text: إِنْ شَاءْ اللَّهْ يِكُونْ فِيهْ عِيشْ هِنَاكْ.

performance.delivery: Close Mostafa's fist around the date and speak directly into his ear. Make «كُلْ» an instruction; let the kindness appear only in the second sentence.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD
issues: The «حِتِّةْ صَاجْ» joke is credible period soldier talk, though it only lightly distinguishes Mahmoud's careful, precise personality.

performance.delivery: Check the web gear while looking along the unarmored line. Aim the question at Sayed as a joke whose answer Mahmoud already knows.

lines.text: هُوَّ مَافِيشْ وَلَا حِتِّةْ صَاجْ عَ الصَّدْرْ؟

lines.speaker: SAYED
issues: «غَطِّي ضَهْرُهْ» is natural but familiar action-dialogue phrasing; the shoulder business gives it more life than the wording alone.

performance.delivery: Reject the idea of armor with a clipped «لَأْ». Mark «إِنْتَ» and «هُوَّ» with the two shoulder slaps, making mutual responsibility physical rather than sentimental.

lines.text: لَأْ. إِنْتَ غَطِّي ضَهْرُهْ… وِهُوَّ يِغَطِّي ضَهْرَكْ.

performance.delivery: Sweep the men toward the aircraft and project over the rotor roar. The repetition is for movement and audibility, never panic.
